listen-inez:
Inez: The Bureau wants another payment tomorrow. I can't keep up.
Milena: I owe them too. Have you told Okafor?
Inez: He knows. We meet after his shift.
Milena: You're seeing him, then.
Inez: Yes. If the Office hears, we'll both lose our jobs.
Milena: Then we keep it between us.
Scout: Clear her loan. Use Okafor.
help-inez-1:
Fixer: Miss Nikolaou, we paid part of your Bureau loan.
Inez: You paid it? I don't even know you.
Fixer: No need to worry. We'll bring the rest.
Inez: Why would you do that?
Fixer: We may ask one small thing later.
Inez: Thank you, but I can't promise anything.
Fixer: You don't have to promise anything today.
Inez: All right. Thank you.
help-inez-2:
Fixer: Miss Nikolaou, we paid the rest of your loan.
Inez: Thank you. What do you want me to do?
Fixer: When I telephone, call Okafor over from his door.
Inez: You know about us. What happens to him?
Fixer: Nothing, if it goes right. He never sees us.
Inez: Why would he leave his post?
Fixer: Say you have something to tell him, not by telephone.
Inez: All right. I'll do it.
Inez: If I see trouble on the square, I'll warn you.
call-inez:
Fixer: Miss Nikolaou, it's time.
Inez: All right.
Inez: How's your shift, love.
Okafor: Quiet. I've got the door till shift's end.
Inez: I have something to tell you, not by telephone.
Okafor: It's you. I'll come over.
Okafor: I'm glad I'll see you.
pressure-inez:
Fixer: Miss Nikolaou, the Office could learn about you and Okafor.
Inez: Please. We would both lose our jobs.
Fixer: We know. I am sorry.
Inez: What do you want?
Fixer: When I telephone, call Okafor away from his door.
Inez: All right. I hate this.
Fixer: I know.
Inez: Leave him out of it as much as you can.
pay-driver:
Zhou: It's been a lean month. Spell out the job.
The Fixer: At the chime, the Councillor gets in.
The Fixer: Drive to the service bay, east yard, round the back.
The Fixer: Wait two minutes, then drive on.
Zhou: Not home.
The Fixer: Not home.
Zhou: I'll send off anyone watching the bay.
Zhou: I won't look at what happens.
The Fixer: We appreciate that.
call-inez-pressure:
Fixer: Miss Nikolaou, it's time.
Inez: All right.
Inez: Okafor, I have something to tell you. Not by telephone.
Okafor: I have the door.
Inez: Please. I need to tell you in person.
Okafor: All right. I'm coming.
---
Inez: Someone knows about us. They looked suspicious.
Okafor: My door's standing empty. I have to go.
